instructions_to_main_agent: Use clean, professional B2B styling with industrial deep slate navy (#0B192C) and brand red (#D32F2F) as subtle highlights.
Implement Lenis or Framer Motion scroll animations for smooth entry effects.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and forms.
Ensure all 9 product pages have complete technical specification tables and individual enquiry triggers.
Keep the mobile sticky action bar visible on screen widths under 768px.
Provide SEO meta tags and titles dynamically per page.
Never show generic placeholder logos; client trust wall must use clear structured text categories with real company names/sectors.
